packageRules.description: Hold @graphql-hive/router-query-planner at the version @graphql-hive/router-runtime depends on. On a 0.0.x version the caret means that exact version, so a newer direct copy installs beside the runtime's own: the runtime loads the old one while the image smoke test and the types use the new one. Move the planner by hand with the router-runtime release whose dependency moves.
